title: Deutsch Master content review status (sidecar)
description: Non-destructive review layer over positional dm-* banks. The runtime banks cannot carry a status field (positional compact arrays merged by dm-lazy.js); this sidecar maps record IDs to review states without touching data or boot code. Nothing reads this file at runtime yet (by design: wiring it into the UI is a separate, reviewed change).

overrides.description: record ID -> review entry; IDs absent here inherit default

rules: approved requires a named human reviewer with German-teaching qualification; scripts, gates and audits can never set approved.
rejected rows stay in the bank (counts/IDs stable) and must be filtered at query time once a consumer honors this file.
stats must equal the bank totals; overrides change stats, never the banks.
